description: This file defines the SystemConfigurationHelper class which provides methods to retrieve system configuration details such as OS info, PHP version, MySQL version, server details, and application version for OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: SystemConfigurationHelper
classes.description: Helper class for retrieving system configuration details such as OS, PHP version, MySQL version, server info, and OrangeHRM version.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsArray
methods.description: Returns an array with system details including OS, PHP, MySQL, server, and OHRM version.

methods.name: getOsDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with details about the operating system name, release, and version.

methods.name: getPhpDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with the current PHP version.

methods.name: getServerDetails
methods.description: Returns the server software details from the $_SERVER superglobal.

methods.name: getMySqlDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with MySQL client version, server version, and connection type (placeholders).

methods.name: getOHRMDetails
methods.description: Returns an array with the OrangeHRM version from configuration.

methods.name: getSystemDetailsAsJson
methods.description: Returns the system details as a JSON-encoded string.

methods.name: getMySqlServerVersion
methods.description: Returns the MySQL server version by accessing the Doctrine database connection attributes.
